name: incident-response-proposal-evidence-gate
description: Enforces the phase-1 incident-response proposal content-shape methodology: every docs/issue-<n>/proposals/incident-response*.md must reference its current-state survey, reference its scout brief (or a stated scout-directive skip reason), carry an explicit adopt/skip list, and tie at least one adopted item back to this role's own decision boundary, per issue-1 (a)(2)-(3).
